scripts.title: Ryn War
scripts.features:
[Ryn Hub | Pordier AT WAR]
This is part of an ongoing project, so I appreciate your patience! I’m working hard to improve it every day. If you encounter any bugs or have suggestions, please don’t hesitate to report them through our community.

Main Features
Universal Aimbot: Includes three lock modes — Rage (CFrame-based for maximum precision), Legit (Mouse-Rel for a natural look), and Smooth (Lerp-based). Comes with FOV Circle, Alive Check, and Team Check.

Player ESP: Enemy highlights with customizable colors, including Rainbow and Pulse modes, with Team Check support.

Flag ESP: Marks enemy-controlled flags in real time and automatically updates on ownership change.

Grenade ESP: Detects active grenades with a dynamic, distance-based warning.

Vehicle ESP: Highlights active enemy vehicles and automatically ignores destroyed ones.

Big Head: Increases enemy head size for easier targeting, fully adjustable.

Ghost / Backtrack: Renders previous player positions with configurable delay and ping support.

Mouse Cursor: Custom emoji cursor with trail and orbit effects.

Performance & Visuals: Includes FPS Boost, RTX-style shaders, and Motion Blur based on camera movement.

Freecam: Free camera with adjustable speed (Toggle: Shift + P).

Panic Button: Instantly disables all active features.

Important:
If you find any issues, please let me know before leaving a bad review. I’m constantly updating the logic to keep it functional and safe.

Key System:
Join our Discord to get the key. It’s a simple process: find the key channel, and you’re ready to test the script!

Credits:
Credits to Exunys for the original aimbot framework base.
